_comment: Multi-tenant config. To add a new location: copy the spokane block, change the key (e.g. 'seattle'), update all fields, add the domain(s), and create a new Resend API key secret named like RESEND_API_KEY_SEATTLE. Then add the new domain in Replit Deployments.
